sentences.en: It took her eight frustrating hours to seduce the bookkeeper.
sentences.zh: 她花了八个小时才说服那个记账员，真是令人泄气。

sentences.en: It's frustrating not being able to convey what I feel.
sentences.zh: 无法表达自己的感受真的很让人沮丧。

sentences.en: I won't be able to stay in such a frustrating job.
sentences.zh: 我无法在这种令人泄气的工作中待下去了。

senses.zh: 产生挫折的；使人沮丧的；令人泄气的
挫败；使受挫折；令人沮丧
